notes: Destructible objects (designer request, 2026-10-12). Placed by the map editor (map file destructibles: [{ id, type, position, name?, structure?, resistance?, initialState?, attackable?, explosion?, linkedTiles? }]; the optional fields override the type's); each type here is data, not a subclass (docs/world-objects.md).

Book: the STA 2e Core Rulebook gives no rules for damaging a person-scale object. PROTOTYPE RULE (designer decision, 2026-10-12): an object has a Structure track and Resistance; each hit does the attack's severity less Resistance (minimum 1) to Structure; at half Structure (rounded down) it is damaged, at 0 destroyed.
PLACEHOLDER NUMBERS (designer: use placeholders, tune later): structure, resistance and every explosion and hazard value below.

explosion: what happens as it is destroyed. radius (tiles, Chebyshev) and severity / injuryType of the Injury it inflicts on everyone in line of fire of the object within the radius, whatever their side (Book p.327: an immediate hazard with the Area effect); null: no blast. hazard / hazardRadius: the lingering hazard it leaves (hazards.json), kept apart from the blast radius.
damagedHazard: a lingering hazard (radius 1, intensity 1) it starts leaking once damaged, or null.
tile ids: ds{Type} intact, ds{Type}Damaged, ds{Type}Destroyed (tiles.json). The object's tile replaces the map tile under it while the map is played (like a challenge object's state tile).

attackDifficulty (PLACEHOLDER, PROTOTYPE RULE): shooting an object is the weapon's own attack task (Attribute + Department, focus) at this Difficulty plus the range modifier, instead of the attack's base Difficulty. An object never defends or takes cover.

explosion.kind (implementation detail): which one-shot animation plays (explosionKinds); hazardIntensity / hazardDuration (hazard rounds, null: until it dissipates) / hazardSpread: the lingering hazard's starting intensity, life and whether it spreads (designer request, 2026-10-14).

PROTOTYPE (placeholders, designer request 2026-10-14): a Force-Field Generator holds its linkedTiles (picked in the editor) as forceFieldTiles.up while it stands, and drops them to forceFieldTiles.down once destroyed. A Structural Support that falls leaves debris (count tiles of the debris tile, within radius, never on anyone), which blocks movement for the rest of the mission.
